messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Government, political systems and organisations in Germany during the 2010s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Germany 2010s election results dataset Bundeswahlleiterin open data 2013 2017
Germany political parties government dataset 2010 2019 GESIS GLES
Germany regional governments political dataset 2010 2019 ParlGov
